content:
Design the circuit for this device.

**Device Description:**
An oval handheld IR remote control. A power button at the top toggles the target device on/off. Below it, volume up and volume down buttons on the left control audio level, while channel up and channel down buttons on the right cycle through channels. An IR LED at the top edge transmits commands to the target device.

**Placed UI Components (use these exact instance_ids):**
- btn_power (tactile_button_6x6) — top face
- btn_vol_up (tactile_button_6x6) — top face
- btn_vol_down (tactile_button_6x6) — top face
- btn_ch_up (tactile_button_6x6) — top face
- btn_ch_down (tactile_button_6x6) — top face
- ir_led (led_5mm) — side face

Include these UI components in your circuit. Add all needed internal components (batteries, resistors, MCU, capacitors, etc.) and design the electrical connections.

- Supply: 3.0V

- Desired current: 15mA
